title: 第89章 五百斤渔获进村，全村惊了
content_zh:
第89章 五百斤渔获进村，全村惊了-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

李青山和大壮等人回到沙河的时候，已经上午九点钟左右了，太阳开始逐渐升起，但好在还不太热。

将电瓶放到小木船上，这次大壮，二壮，赵红旗轮流上手电鱼，这种事情还是比较简单的，没啥难度，一条条肥硕的大鱼落在船舱内，发出嘭嘭的声响。

中午十二点！

又是五百斤渔获，装满了木板车，满满当当的。

“山哥，咱们现在去土乡不？”大壮开口问道。

“算了，不去了！”

李青山摆了摆手道：“早晨还好卖，中午可就不好卖了，而且现在天气太热了，这些鱼拉过去卖相也不好，放在大街上卖相就更不好了，全部拉回家，全部晒成咸鱼干，留着咱们以后慢慢吃，家里这两天也没啥肉了。”

“而且折腾一上午了，昨天睡得也晚，整完了赶紧回去睡觉，等到明天凌晨再来电，咱们也不要多，一上午整个五百来斤就行了，不过这生意也不长久，这地方的人也不可能天天开荤吃大鱼的。”

“过几天，准备准备，还是要上山！”

“你们自己整的弹弓，平日里没啥事的时候，也多练习练习！”

“别到时候整上了猎枪，一个个抓了瞎，瞄不准。”

赵红旗三人连忙点头应下，心中对李青山越发的敬佩。

今天卖鱼一共是四十五块钱，按照之前商议的，其中两成归大壮，二壮和赵红旗，也就是九块钱，按照这个算是一个人三块钱，这没人三块钱超过了之前定下一天不超过两块钱的规矩。

所以，一人是两块钱。

李青山这次给了大壮，二壮，赵红旗一人两块钱，共计六块！

三人脸上乐呵呵的。

“嘿，就是国企里面的职工，今天都没我大壮赚的多啊！”大壮小心收好自己的老婆本道。

“两块钱，能买小二十斤玉米面呢，够我一家子吃上好几天的了。”赵红旗望着手中的两块钱，长长松了一口气道。

大中午的。

石溪村，烈日当空，空气中满是沉闷的气氛。

李青山一行人推着板车便进入了村子，浓烈的鱼腥味开始朝着四周飘荡，木轮车的轮子压在地上，发出嘎吱嘎吱的声响，农村的生活祥和又平静。

重活一世，李青山十分享受这种感觉。

真好。

“哎呦，青山，这是哪里捕的鱼，这么多嘞？”就在这时，村里的单身汉保山便盯着李青山的木板车震惊道。

木板车的四周是用几个装着鱼的麻袋围起来的，中间的鱼则是没用麻袋装着，主要是麻袋不够了，简单用水草遮盖了一下，所以满满当当的渔获，一下就能看了个清楚。

Chapter 89 Five hundred kilograms of fish caught came into the village, and the whole village was shocked - "Cash the Mountain 1957: Two kilograms of pork in exchange for a wife"

When Li Qingshan, Dazhuang and others returned to Shahe, it was already around nine o'clock in the morning. The sun began to rise gradually, but fortunately it was not too hot yet.

Putting the battery on the small wooden boat, this time the big fish, the second big fish, Zhao Hongqi took turns to use the electric fish. This kind of thing is relatively simple, not difficult, one after another fat fish fell into the cabin, making a bang bang sound.

Twelve noon!

Another five hundred kilograms of catch filled the wooden cart, full to the brim.

"Brother Shan, shall we go to Tuxiang now?" Da Zhuang asked.

"Forget it, I won't go!"

Li Qingshan waved his hand and said: "It's easy to sell in the morning, but it's not easy to sell at noon. Moreover, the weather is too hot now. These fish won't look good if they are taken there, and even worse if they are put on the street. Take them all home and dry them into dried salted fish for us to eat later. There is no meat at home these two days."

"And I've been working hard all morning. I slept late yesterday. I'll go back to bed as soon as I'm done. I won't call you until early tomorrow morning. We don't need more. Five hundred kilograms in one morning will be enough. But this business won't last long, and people in this place can't eat meat and fish every day."

"In a few days, get ready, we still have to go up the mountain!"

"You guys have made your own slingshots. Practice more on weekdays when you have nothing else to do!"

"Don't use a shotgun when the time comes and you'll be blinded and unable to aim accurately."

Zhao Hongqi and the others nodded in agreement, admiring Li Qingshan even more in their hearts.

The total cost of selling fish today is forty-five yuan. According to the previous discussion, 20% of it goes to Dazhuang, Erzhuang and Zhao Hongqi, which is nine yuan. According to this, it is three yuan per person. The three yuan for no one exceeds the previous rule of no more than two yuan a day.

So, it’s two dollars per person.

This time Li Qingshan gave Dazhuang, Erzhuang, and Zhao Hongqi two yuan each, a total of six yuan!

The three of them had cheerful faces.

"Hey, even the employees in state-owned enterprises don't make as much as me, Da Zhuang!" Da Zhuang carefully kept his wife's words.

"Two yuan can buy twenty kilograms of cornmeal, which is enough for my family to eat for several days." Zhao Hongqi looked at the two yuan in his hand and breathed a long sigh of relief.

At noon.

In Shixi Village, the sun is blazing and the air is filled with a dull atmosphere.

Li Qingshan and his party entered the village pushing the cart. The strong smell of fish began to float around. The wheels of the wooden cart pressed against the ground, making a crunching sound. Life in the countryside was peaceful and peaceful.

Li Qingshan enjoyed this feeling of reviving his life.

very nice.

"Oh, Qingshan, where did you catch so many fish?" At this moment, Baoshan, a bachelor in the village, stared at Li Qingshan's wooden cart and said in shock.

The wooden cart is surrounded by several sacks containing fish. The fish in the middle are not packed in sacks. The main reason is that there are not enough sacks. They are simply covered with water plants, so the full catch can be seen clearly at a glance.
